dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible gradual narrowing of the 2D silhouette from the maximum width at the mid-section to a sharp apex at the posterior extremity.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical outward curvature on the left lateral margin compared to the straighter right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-to-medium grey baseline; normalized intensity is higher in the mid-body and lower toward the anterior head region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse dark-grey clusters concentrated around the blowhole and along the anterior-medial axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the darker anterior regions and the lighter posterior regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Cluster of approximately 6-8 distinct, light-toned circular spots on the left anterior-mid dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of light-toned circular marks on the left side, indicating healed epidermal disruptions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined, dark elliptical blowhole aperture at the anterior end; distinct linear high-contrast ridge running along the posterior midline.
